6\. Unrecorded rooms receive owner reminders 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
waiting_request() rejects a different current room but permits current_room() to return None.
If the state says waiting for owner without a valid room in either the playbook or machine block,
an old request in the watchdog's room can produce a reminder despite no record that this is the
current room.
